channel.name: The World With Numbers
channel.niche: data-driven educational content, facts, rankings, statistics
channel.description:
The World With Numbers explores our planet through data — rankings, statistics, comparisons, and the numbers most people have never stopped to look at.

Every video is a data-first deep dive: no opinions, no spin, no filler. Just carefully sourced facts, visualized clearly, and presented in a way that makes the world feel sharper, stranger, and more surprising than before.

Topics range from global wealth and poverty to rare materials, population extremes, historical trends, and the hidden statistics that quietly define how the world actually works.

If you're the kind of person who finds a well-made chart more interesting than a hot take — this channel is for you.

New videos weekly. Subscribe and turn on notifications.

— Rankings • Statistics • Comparisons • Global Data • Educational Facts
channel.positioningStatement: The World With Numbers is for people who are unsatisfied with surface-level knowledge — those who want to understand the world not through opinion, but through the raw weight of data. Every video delivers a clean, fact-first perspective on how things are ranked, measured, and compared across our planet. When you understand the numbers, you see things others don't.
channel.tagline: See the world differently. See it with numbers.
channel.taglineAlt: Data-driven stories that reveal how the world really works.

strategy.phase1: Pure neutral data content — rankings, comparisons, statistical facts. Grow audience, establish authority.
strategy.phase2: Gradually surface uncomfortable global truths through data alone. No commentary needed — numbers do the talking.

phase2Trigger.notes: Phase 2 transition is optional and gradual. Start with Hidden Statistics pillar. Never editorialize — let data speak.

brand.logoConceptDirection: Single meridian-line arc that simultaneously reads as a rising graph line. Accent color #E88CA5 on dusty grey background. Works in full color, single-color white, and single-color black.

accessibility.notes: All text colors verified against bgTop/bgBottom for WCAG AA compliance

content.defaultTone: neutral-analytic, authoritative, curiosity-driven — numbers speak for themselves
content.targetAudience: 18-35, globally curious, English-speaking, prefers facts over opinions

contentPillars.name: Rankings & Lists
contentPillars.description: Most/least, richest/poorest, biggest/smallest. Core engine of the channel.
exampleTopics: Countries with the shortest life expectancy

contentPillars.name: Hidden Statistics
contentPillars.description: A number most people have never heard — but can't un-know. Primary Phase 2 vehicle.
exampleTopics: Weight of all human-made objects vs. all living things

contentPillars.name: Comparisons & Scale
contentPillars.description: Makes abstract numbers tangible through relative scale.
exampleTopics: GDP of countries vs. company revenues
Distance light travels in a second vs. Earth's circumference

contentPillars.name: Trends Over Time
contentPillars.description: Historical data arcs — how things changed over decades and centuries.

contentPillars.name: Index Releases & Annual Data
contentPillars.description: Time-sensitive data — new global reports, annual indexes, breaking statistics. High search-volume opportunity at release time.
